title: Sazmining Brings Proto’s Immersion Hashboards to Individual Owners, With 0% Financing From $1,397 Down
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Sazmining Brings Proto’s Immersion Hashboards to Individual Owners, With 0% Financing From $1,397 Down Proto immersion hashboards, built for efficiency and long service life, are now available for outright purchase through Sazmining’s mining-as-a-service platform, with mining rewards paid directly to the owner’s wallet. This post Sazmining Brings Proto’s Immersion Hashboards to Individual Owners, With 0% Financing From $1,397 Down first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Bitcoin Magazine .
